_comment: Copy to /etc/vast-paralon-dual/config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_on_paralon_rental: REQUIRED, no default. keep_vast_listed = Vast stays listed while Paralon is rented (a Vast booking reclaims the Paralon spot rental). unlist_vast = Vast is unlisted while Paralon is rented and relisted afterwards.
_vast_listing: Used for every relist. An unlisted Vast machine reports no live price, so your prices must live here. Keys map to `vastai list machine` flags.
